evidence.finding: Current candidate on upsample_bilinear2d-timing-1 is one kernel, 1024 programs, task 432us. Per-block: mte2_time 8.0us of 16.6us (mte2_ratio 0.48) at only 1.6 GB/s active read bandwidth, mte3_time 4.05us at 3.8 GB/s, scalar_wait 12.7us, vec 7.6us. Total read+write traffic is only 30MB in ~424us (~70 GB/s) while the reference moves ~107MB in 245us, so the candidate is DMA-issue/latency bound, not bandwidth bound.

aiv_mte2_instructions sum 144384 over 1024 blocks (~141 mte2 issues per block) versus reference 8772, yet a block does only 48 logical row loads, i.e. about 3 DMA issues per 256-byte row load; the reference moves ~6 KB per mte2 issue, the candidate ~95 bytes. Per-iteration issue/predication overhead, not arithmetic, is the gap.

The 2x kernel body carries an i1 mask on every memory op: tt.load with %m_5, %xr (m & has_left), %xl (m & has_right), and both tt.store with %store_ok_85 = andi(%store_w_6, splat(i < IH)) recomputed per iteration on 256 lanes. IH/IW/OH/OW arrive as runtime i32 args, so the compiler cannot fold j < IW, j >= 1, j < IW-1 or i < IH even though the exact-2x path guarantees IW == BLOCK_IW and the tile is chosen from the source height.
Public contract is run(input, output_size, align_corners=False, scales_h=None, scales_w=None) returning out; any 2x-only specialization must keep the general path for all other shapes.
Original-source profiling only; it describes the starter, not the current candidate, so it is used only as historical background for which cases are large.

hypothesis: In the exact-2x path every row iteration issues 3 predicated 256-byte loads and 2 predicated 512-byte stores plus 256-lane mask construction, because the geometry (IH, IW, OH, OW) and all bounds are runtime values. Making the 2x geometry constexpr (IW == BLOCK_IW and TILE_I divides IH become compile-time facts), removing every load/store mask, and clamping neighbour row bases with scalar max/min instead of per-lane masks should collapse each row load to one plain contiguous DMA and delete the per-iteration mask/compare work that dominates the measured 16.6us per block.
change: Triton-layer edit of the exact-2x kernel only: pass IH, IW, TILE_I as constexpr, derive OW = 2*IW, drop the runtime IW/IH/OH/OW arguments and every load/store mask, clamp neighbour row bases with scalar max(base-1,0)/min(base+1, numel-IW), fix only the two boundary columns with constant-mask tl.where, and choose TILE_I on the host as a divisor of IH (16/8/4/2/1) so stores need no mask. Fast path restricted to power-of-two IW (IW == BLOCK_IW); every other shape keeps the unchanged general gather kernel. Arithmetic, weights, dtype handling and run() are unchanged.
expected: upsample_bilinear2d-timing-1 full-call time should fall from ~424us toward the 245us reference (part of the gap closed); other exact-2x cases (timing-0/2/3/5) should improve in the same direction; non-2x shapes are untouched.
validation: Bridge preflight (compile + supplementary contract checks), then host formal 24-case evaluation; compare per-case timing-1 latency against the recorded 424.4us vs 245.2us pair and confirm all 24 formal and 30 supplementary checks still pass.
alternatives: Batch several source rows into 2-D tiles so one DMA covers many rows: rejected this call because the required (TILE_I, IW, 2) join/interleave form is recorded in the source as failing BishengIR stride alignment, and it would bundle an untested layout change with this one.
Two-pass separable (vertical blend kernel + horizontal expand kernel): rejected because the horizontal pass still needs one interleave and one store per row, increasing total DMA issues.
Switch the blends from fp32 to fp16/bf16 arithmetic: rejected as a numerics change unrelated to the measured DMA-bound bottleneck.
Leave the source unchanged: rejected because the per-row predication is visible in the current TTIR and is removable without changing any arithmetic.
discriminating_observation: If per-row DMA issue/predication overhead is the bottleneck, the mask-free constexpr kernel should reduce mte2 issues per block and block time well below the measured mte2_time 8.0us while total GM traffic stays near 30MB; if instead the 2x path is bound by interleave/layout ops, block time will barely move and vec/misc time will stay dominant.
